confidence_notes: City-reported restaurant prices provide a useful basis, though lower-cost casual options and tourist-facing venues vary widely. Cocktail and wine estimates reflect typical Valletta and Malta bar prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic year-typical estimates from the supplied comparables; no live booking prices were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Valletta is estimated above Brno and Ljubljana, and around or above Cardiff for hotel rooms, reflecting destination demand and limited historic-center supply. Hostel prices are estimated above Riga and Brno, with some allowance for Malta's tourism premium.
